technical-summary: Strengthened HI14 offline multi-GPU evidence validation with explicit graph capture lifecycle stages, per-device replay dispatch coverage, topology identity consistency, and single-device support while preserving disabled-graph behavior and wire formats.
user-summary-candidate: HI14 graph-capture evidence validation now fails closed unless enabled claims prove the capture lifecycle, replay coverage on every device, and topology identity consistency; disabled-graph and valid single-device evidence remain supported.
